courses.overview: 由微孔、增層與高密度逃線延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend microvias, buildup and dense escape routing into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 多層印刷電路板製造
related.why: HDI 是多層互連向更高密度的延伸。
related.whyEn: HDI extends multilayer interconnects toward higher density.
related.transfer: HDI 是多層互連向更高密度的延伸。
related.transferEn: HDI extends multilayer interconnects toward higher density.
related.difference: 孔長、孔底和壓合次數改變可靠度與成本。
related.differenceEn: Via depth, bottoms and lamination cycles alter reliability/cost.
practice: 把「BGA 逃線」的概念圖與「多層印刷電路板製造」的輸入輸出對照。
比較截面的底部殘渣與側壁錐度。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：孔長、孔底和壓合次數改變可靠度與成本。
practiceEn: Compare the bga escape concept map with inputs/outputs of Multilayer printed-circuit-board manufacturing.
Compare bottom residue and wall taper in sections.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Via depth, bottoms and lamination cycles alter reliability/cost.

related.title: 電路板邊界掃描測試
related.why: 密集板的不可接觸節點提高邊界掃描價值。
related.whyEn: Inaccessible dense-board nodes increase boundary-scan value.
related.transfer: 密集板的不可接觸節點提高邊界掃描價值。
related.transferEn: Inaccessible dense-board nodes increase boundary-scan value.
related.difference: 掃描可驗連通，但無法取代微孔截面和疲勞證據。
related.differenceEn: Scan checks connectivity but cannot replace microvia sections/fatigue evidence.
practice: 把「增層配置」的概念圖與「電路板邊界掃描測試」的輸入輸出對照。
以界面缺口和導通資料交叉判讀。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：掃描可驗連通，但無法取代微孔截面和疲勞證據。
practiceEn: Compare the buildup configuration concept map with inputs/outputs of PCB boundary-scan testing.
Correlate interface gaps with continuity data.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Scan checks connectivity but cannot replace microvia sections/fatigue evidence.

courses.summaryEn: High-density interconnect circuit boards links components, systems and validation through microvias, buildup and dense escape routing. The location gives public supply-chain or case geography.
courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，保留本課的基本模型，重新核對材料、規模、環境與驗收邊界。
courses.connectionEn: Transfer the basic models to related courses while rechecking materials, scale, environment and acceptance boundaries.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Eurocircuits 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。焊墊節距、通道寬度及孔盤共同限制逃線。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「微孔、增層與高密度逃線」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Eurocircuits provides a traceable starting point. Pad pitch, channel width and via lands constrain escape routing. Independently authored models connect this to microvias, buildup and dense escape routing; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：堆疊節省面積但界面受力路徑不同於錯位微孔。 以「畫出熱膨脹應變如何穿越各孔底界面。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: Stacking saves area but changes stress paths relative to staggered vias. Practice interpretation using: Draw thermal-strain paths across each bottom interface. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
